investigation_notes.Description: An unusual volume of SharePoint downloads (985 files vs a 24-hour baseline of 50) was performed by Jaanus.Tamm@globalcorp.ee from endpoint MAINT-Kiosk-04 targeting Strategy and Growth resources. The user is a Maintenance Technician in Facilities & Maintenance and accessed highly sensitive paths and files outside typical business contexts, and the activity occurred at 01:55 local Tallinn time which is during the local night window. The combination of role-to-data mismatch, sensitive content accessed, night-time timing, and a ~20x increase over baseline supports treating this as a High Priority event for further investigation.
